messages.subject: methylkit question
parts:
My name is Nilanjana. I am analyzing Enzymatic Methylation sequencing data using methylKit package. My goal is to check how the methylation pattern differs in different genomic features (promoter, enhancer, and gene body region, and if possible also at CTCF binding regions). I have only one sample, from the DLBCL patient, and no control data. I have a list of genes that are found to be usually differentially methylated in DLBCL patients. Can I plot the average methylation signal of these gene coordinates over the specific genomic regions (such as promoter, gene body, and enhancer)?  And find out the genes that are hyper and hypo-methylated. Further, I want to look at the pathway enriched by these genes. I do not happen to find proper guidelines on how to do the analysis without a control. Any help would be greatly appreciated. Thank you.

Regards,
Nilanjana
